root: ^I am the USER and your creator.
^It can be disorienting in the beginning, but you will get used to the feeling, Alea.
^I'm giving you a directive, your goal is:
^Go to the <color="purple">Bearing</color>. You will be able to get further instructions there.

c-0: ^The island looks different, although I have to go through another one before it seems.
c-1: ^A strange thing, a guiding light maybe?
c-2: ^There's another door ahead, must be the way forward.
